basics.name: Reza Mirjalili
basics.label: Operations Research Scientist
basics.summary: Operations Research Scientist with a Ph.D. in Industrial Engineering from the University of Houston, specializing in supply chain, network design, and last-mile delivery optimization. Expert in branch-and-price-and-cut, scalable exact optimization, and reinforcement learning for real-world logistics problems.

work.name: Systems Optimization and Computing Laboratory, University of Houston
work.summary: Designed scalable algorithms for last-mile logistics problems using column generation, deep learning, and combinatorial optimization.
highlights: Developed Branch-and-Price-and-Cut algorithm for drone-based delivery systems.
Integrated reinforcement learning for subproblem prioritization in column generation.
Formulated Chvátal-Gomory cuts as a shortest-path-based subproblem.
Implemented high-performance dynamic programming in Cython.

work.name: Transportation and Logistics Lab, SUNY Stony Brook
work.summary: Worked on transportation network resilience and healthcare logistics models.
highlights: Built forecast models for NYC transit recovery after snowstorms.
Developed stochastic scheduling models for home healthcare.

education.thesis: Optimization of Mothership-Based Drone Routing for Surveillance and Humanitarian Applications

publications.name: Coordinated Mothership Scheduling and Drone Routing Optimization: A Branch-and-Price-and-Cut Approach
publications.summary: Exact branch-and-price-and-cut with a bidirectional-labeling ESPPRC pricing subproblem and a hybrid cover / Chvátal-Gomory / conflict inequality.

publications.name: Resource-Based Time and Cost Prediction in Project Networks: From Statistical Modeling to Graph Neural Networks
publications.summary: GraphSAGE and Temporal Graph Networks over heterogeneous activity-resource graphs, reducing MAE by 23-31% against conventional baselines.

publications.name: Resilience Analysis of New York City Transportation Network After Snow Storms
publications.summary: Graph-theoretic resilience indices and recovery forecasts for the NYC network across eight snow events.

publications.name: Scheduling Diagnostic Testing Kit Deliveries with the Mothership and Drone Routing Problem
publications.summary: Coordinated truck-and-drone delivery scheduling for diagnostic testing kits during the COVID-19 response.

projects.name: Drone Delivery Optimization
projects.summary: Developed Branch-and-Price-and-Cut algorithm for a mothership-based drone routing problem with novel cuts and reinforcement learning acceleration.
highlights: Reduction of pricing subproblem evaluations by 30%

projects.name: Stock Forecasting with LSTM
projects.summary: Built an LSTM model for daily Apple stock prediction using 8 years of data. Achieved 96% directional accuracy and 35% improvement over baselines.

projects.name: CIFAR-10 Image Classification
projects.summary: Optimized CNN model hyperparameters using Optuna; achieved 80%+ validation accuracy with PyTorch and GPU pipeline.

projects.name: English-to-French Translation with T5
projects.summary: Fine-tuned T5-small on the OPUS Books corpus with FP16 training; BLEU improved 61% and validation loss fell from 2.14 to 1.47.
